name: Vera Blanc and the Unseen Enemy
source:
Take on the role of Vera Blanc, a beautiful young woman with the extraordinary ability to read other people's minds!
Daughter of Emmanuel Blanc, Vera left a life of luxury to work alongside paranormal detective Brandon Mackey.
The game ending you get depends on choices you make. Game play includes a challenging mini-game.
Vera Blanc immerses you in the world of the supernatural as you play the detective!
Will you be able to solve the mystery?

In this game Vera Blanc and her partner Brandon Mackey take a well earned vacation, only to discover someone is attacking crewmen on their ship. 

[From [url=http://wolflore.net/viewtopic.php?f=37&t=1212]Wolflore[/url]]
translation:
扮演维拉·布兰克 (Vera Blanc) 的角色，她是一位美丽的年轻女子，拥有读心术的非凡能力！
作为伊曼纽尔·布兰克 (Emmanuel Blanc) 的女儿，维拉放弃了奢华的生活，与超自然侦探布兰登·麦基 (Brandon Mackey) 一起工作。
你得到的游戏结局取决于你所做的选择。游戏玩法包括具有挑战性的迷你游戏。
当你扮演侦探时，维拉·布兰克 (Vera Blanc) 让你沉浸在超自然的世界中！
你能解开谜团吗？

在这款游戏中，维拉·布兰克 (Vera Blanc) 和她的搭档布兰登·麦基 (Brandon Mackey) 度过了一个应得的假期，却发现有人正在攻击他们船上的船员。

[来自[url=http://wolflore.net/viewtopic.php?f=37&t=1212]Wolflore[/url]]
